title: Uniform L1 distortion for bounded treewidth
exact_target: For each positive integer k, does a finite C(k) bound the $L^{1}$ embedding distortion of all finite connected graphs with positive real edge lengths and a tree decomposition having at most k vertices per bag? The constant is independent of graph size and lengths, and embeddings may use an arbitrary real $L^{1}$ target and positive scale.
